layout: each dataset in <folder>/; downloaded archives in <folder>/_zips/; extracted data beside _zips

access_values.manual: needs Austin's login, form or access approval

datasets.name: JazzSAMBA
datasets.license: permissive MIT-style licence in the dataset's LICENSE file (keep the copyright notice; derived files are estimates, provided as-is); Zenodo lists none
datasets.extract: unzip every zip into the dataset root; the zips share one tree (async/, sync/ beside songs.csv)
datasets.sax: Alto/tenor sax stems for 50 async + 26 sync songs (2 takes each, plus async extras); MIDI for sax is machine transcription only (*.transcribed.derived.mid); ground-truth MIDI only for piano/drums; sync has debleeded stems

datasets.name: TinySOL
datasets.extract: tar -xzf TinySOL.tar.gz in the dataset root; metadata CSV sits beside it
datasets.sax: Winds/Sax_Alto/ordinario: 99 single notes, 33 pitches C#3-A5 x pp/mf/ff; pitch in filename and metadata CSV

datasets.name: URMP

archives.note: on disk this came as doi_10_5061_dryad_ng3r749__v20190320.zip containing the PDF

datasets.extract: tar -xzf Dataset.tar.gz -> Dataset/ (44 pieces + Supplementary_Files)
datasets.sax: 10 pieces with sax, 11 sax tracks: AuSep_*_sax_*.wav stems with human-checked F0s_*.txt (time, Hz) and Notes_*.txt (onset s, Hz, duration s); plus mixes, MIDI/PDF scores, video

datasets.name: Charlie Parker Aligned Omnibook
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> CharlieParkerAlignedOmnibookPublication/ (also writes a __MACOSX/ folder)
datasets.sax: Charlie Parker alto solos: score-audio pairs with aligned MIDI and downbeats (no isolated stems)

datasets.name: FiloBass
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> 'FiloBass ISMIR Publication/' (the folder on disk was moved from an earlier extraction in ~/Music/Datasets; identical to the zip's file list)
datasets.sax: No sax: jazz bass stems with aligned MIDI/MusicXML. Useful for the band context only

datasets.name: ChoraleBricks
datasets.extract: unzip 01_AudioAndAnnotations.zip into the dataset root -> 01_AudioAndAnnotations/<song_id>/
datasets.sax: Real recordings: 20 alto sax (*_as.wav) + 18 baritone sax (*_bs.wav) tracks across 10 chorales; per track human-checked notes CSV (start/end s, sounding MIDI pitch, cents) and F0 CSV (s, Hz), plus score alignments and MIDI/MusicXML/MEI

datasets.name: Weimar Jazz Database
datasets.license: not stated on the download page; check jazzomat.hfm-weimar.de before redistribution
datasets.extract: wjazzd.db is used as-is (SQLite, kept in the root, not in _zips); unzip the MIDI zip -> midi_unquant/
datasets.sax: 456 hand-transcribed solos (157 tenor, 80 alto, 23 soprano, 11 baritone sax), with notes, beats, chords; no audio (recordings must be sourced separately)

datasets.name: GoodSounds
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> good-sounds/ (database.sqlite + sound_files/)
datasets.sax: 3,360 sax recordings (alto/tenor/soprano/baritone, one player) of single notes and scales in 9 sax_*/saxo_* folders; pitch, technique and goodness ratings in database.sqlite

datasets.name: Medley-solos-DB
datasets.extract: tar -xzf Medley-solos-DB.tar.gz in the dataset root (flat WAVs); metadata CSV stays in _zips
datasets.sax: 477 three-second tenor sax clips (instrument_id 5); instrument label only, no notes

datasets.name: OrchideaSOL (metadata)
datasets.extract: none; the CSV stays in _zips
datasets.sax: Metadata only: 377 alto sax rows (pitch, MIDI, dynamics, technique). Audio is a separate manual entry

datasets.name: MedleyDB-Pitch pyin notes
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> medleydb-pitch-pyin-notes/
datasets.sax: 103 machine-made (pYIN) note CSVs for the MedleyDB-Pitch stems; not ground truth; audio is a separate manual entry

datasets.name: SaxTimbre

archives.checksum_source: computed locally; Dataverse builds this zip on request, so its md5 may change between downloads; check per-file sizes instead

datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> one folder per technique
datasets.sax: 191 tenor sax WAVs in technique folders (Bisbigliando, Flutter, Growling, Long Vibrato, Long NON Vibrato, Multiphonics, Quarter-Tones, Slap, Subtones); folder name is the only label

datasets.name: University of Iowa MIS (sax)
datasets.license: freely usable without restrictions, per the MIS site
datasets.extract: none needed; each file is saved at its relative path under the dataset root. The 20 .zip files are Iowa's own bundles of the same AIFFs (duplicates), kept packed
datasets.sax: 82 alto + 88 soprano sax AIFFs (plus 1 ambient-silence file and 20 duplicate zip bundles = 191 files). 2014 set: one note per file, ff, vib/nonvib, pitch in filename. Older set: one chromatic run per file (e.g. C4B4) at pp/mf/ff, vib/novib; notes must be segmented

datasets.name: Philharmonia (woodwind)
datasets.license: Philharmonia sound-sample terms (free to use; check the page before redistributing)
datasets.extract: unzip Woodwind.zip into the dataset root, then unzip Woodwind/saxophone/saxophone.zip in place (other instrument zips left packed)
datasets.sax: 733 sax MP3s in Woodwind/saxophone; pitch, length, dynamic and technique in the filename

datasets.name: Vibrato Dataset
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> 'Vibrato Dataset/' (also writes __MACOSX/)
datasets.sax: 53 alto sax WAVs in Good-sounds-Altosax/; vibrato presence and parameters in vibrato_dataset_GT.csv

datasets.name: Register Control in Saxophone Playing
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> meguia-register_control_saxophone-<hash>/; the Zenodo file key contains a slash, so it's saved flat
datasets.sax: 280 sax audio files with mouth-pressure and lip-force sensor data and reviewed overtone labels (CSV); register and altissimo work

datasets.name: Bach10
datasets.license: see Bach10 Dataset_v1.0.pdf inside the dataset (not checked)
datasets.access_note: download link is a Google Form; Austin downloaded it 2026-11-02
datasets.extract: unzip into the dataset root -> Bach10_v1.1/NN-Name/
datasets.sax: 10 Bach chorales; real tenor saxophone part (NN-Name-saxphone.wav, sic) with ground-truth F0 (NN-Name-GTF0s.mat) and notes (NN-Name-GTNotes.mat) for all 4 parts, plus mix, MIDI and score alignment (.txt/.asl)

datasets.name: OrchideaSOL (audio)

archives.checksum_source: computed locally (Austin's download from the Ircam Forum, 2026-11-02); per-file md5s in OrchideaSOL2020.md5.txt all verified

datasets.license: Ircam Forum licence for audio (https://forum.ircam.fr/legal/contrat-de-licence-forum-ircam/); no licence file in the zip
datasets.access_note: needs a free Ircam Forum account; Austin downloaded it 2026-11-02
datasets.extract: zip is over 4 GB: extract with `ditto -x -k` (macOS unzip misreads it). Gives _OrchideaSOL2020_release/OrchideaSOL2020/<family>/<instrument>/<technique>/*.wav; metadata CSV paths are relative to OrchideaSOL2020/
datasets.sax: 377 alto sax WAVs in Winds/Sax_Alto across 14 techniques (ordinario 99, ordinario_high_register 42, slap_pitched 46, double_tonguing 33, flatterzunge 33, sforzato 31, bisbigliando 29, aeolian 26, discolored_fingering 12, key_click 12, harmonic_fingering 9, slap_unpitched 3, blow_without_reed 1, kiss 1); pitch, MIDI, dynamics and technique per file in the metadata CSV

datasets.name: Filosax
datasets.extract: TBD once obtained
datasets.sax: Jazz sax stems from several players with note-level JSON annotations; full and lite versions

datasets.name: MedleyDB-Pitch
datasets.access_note: Zenodo access request (requested by Austin on 2026-11-02)
datasets.extract: TBD once obtained
datasets.sax: Pitch-tracking subset with human-checked F0 per stem, including sax
